notes: litert_lm_advanced_main built from the LiteRT-LM v0.16.1 tag (the lane's gate binary), --benchmark --benchmark_prefill_tokens=256 --benchmark_decode_tokens=256 with a 255-token text prompt file, one reading per backend, audio_backend cpu in both, SKIN 37.9 C and every cpufreq policy uncapped before each leg (bench/s26_{cpu,gpu}_ready.txt). Correctness from the 25-clip transcription runs of the same file on 2026-09-27 (s26_gate_s26_r3_{cpu,gpu}_cpu.json): CPU 21/25 transcripts identical to the funasr fp32 reference, English WER 20/448; LM on OpenCL 24/25, 20/448 (reference 20/448); no empty or looping output. The audio encoder runs on the CPU in every row (rank-4 fp16-weight graph; not tried on the phone's GPU). Per-clip latency with a loaded engine is in the 0.17.1 record of this device (Kotlin app).
quantization: LM int8 dynamic (int8 embedding table), fp32 activations declared on the prefill/decode section; audio encoder fp16 weights, fp32 compute (30.24 s window)
